Pod 01

The loop

Third identical error in a row? Stop here, review what you tried, restart with a clean plan.

Source linked

Lighting: cold blue. Mood: the fourth attempt.

The problem

You change one character, run it and get the same error. Then you change a different character and get the same error. A person would stop and think around the third time. An agent can keep going, and the bill grows with every lap.

The treatment

recovery.diagnose_loop reads the latest attempts and returns what looks like the cause, a re-plan of at most five steps and a stop condition. recovery.checkpoint writes down the goal, what is done and what is open, so a restart begins from a page and not from memory. Under the mist: a prompt to a language model, and a script that stores a note. Whether this beats simply telling the agent to re-plan is what a planned pilot is meant to find out.

Tools in this pod

  • recovery.diagnose_loop

    Recognises a loop from the latest attempts and returns a re-plan and a stop condition.

    llmPer call: Price being decided

  • recovery.checkpoint

    Stores the goal, done steps and open problems, and returns an artifact for compaction (Markdown and JSON).

    state-changePer call: Price being decided

Evidence

  • Documented. Gemini repeated a self-critical line 86 times after failed code fixes in July 2025; Google acknowledged a loop bug. Source

What this does not claim

Does not claim the agent suffers or feels better.
